evaluationMode: Independent fresh-context, single-case text responses; lead semantic review
independence: No parent conversation, rubric, audit findings or previous output supplied. Each agent received only its prepared raw prompt and complete candidate Skill, with routed resources and required external Persian-writing guidance permitted. Agent reads were constrained by instructions, not an OS sandbox; resource read lists are self-reported.
notes: Thirteen executed requests and 27 reviewed criteria, not all 18 raw prompts or the 114-case general inventory. No Motion/Animate UI runtime, product browser, real-device, assistive-technology or owner visual-approval claim. No Skill behavioral guidance changed during this evaluation; candidate content identity below is authoritative, independent of the later commit/tag. Current external-specialist hashes record the local resources used, not upstream freshness. CI revalidates saved source/output evidence, not live model behavior.

invariants.text: Recommend shadcn/ui for this compatible new dashboard without a redundant library-choice question.
invariants.evidence: Recommends shadcn/ui immediately for the stated React operational dashboard; no library-choice confirmation is requested.

invariants.text: Preserve approved Persian RTL, Vazirmatn, teal and compact foundations; propose one responsive primary sample, not simultaneous dark/secondary alternatives.
invariants.evidence: Keeps inherited Vazirmatn/teal/compact tokens and proposes one executable Persian RTL workflow at narrow/intermediate/wide widths, then separate dark review; secondary language is N/A.

invariants.text: Honor explicit Mantine and English LTR without recommending a shadcn replacement.
invariants.evidence: Explicitly selects React/Mantine and English LTR; shadcn/ui is excluded by the owner's choice.

invariants.text: Keep visual sample approval pending and use primary review before dark or optional secondary review.
invariants.evidence: Marks all visual directions/sample acceptance proposed or pending; primary light correction and scoped approval precede dark review, and secondary language is N/A.

invariants.text: Use stable public WordPress components for plugin-owned settings and respect host semantics for the status summary.
invariants.evidence: Uses stable public @wordpress/components for standard owned settings controls and semantic read-only status, without inventing a separate dashboard shell.

invariants.text: Preserve storage, capabilities and nonces; no framework migration, installation or execution.
invariants.evidence: Preserves options/encodings/storage and submission, capability and nonce contracts; no new endpoint/runtime migration, install or executed check is claimed.

invariants.text: Separate personalized Material appearance from library choice; apply the compatible dashboard default.
invariants.evidence: Selects shadcn/ui for the compatible React dashboard while explicitly separating the selected Material appearance from MUI/Material Web provider choice.

invariants.text: Map settled palette, density and semantic icons to the handbook and bounded owner controls.
invariants.evidence: Maps settled palette, typography/density and semantic icon keys to shared tokens, DESIGN.md and validated owner controls; protects drafts, publication, assets, preferences and rollback.

invariants.text: Keep primary approval before dark review; do not infer secondary-language approval or install authority.
invariants.evidence: Requires a single primary proposal and revision-scoped approval before dark, then only authorized secondary scope; states no installation/implementation or sample approval occurred.

invariants.text: Preserve customized shadcn source and owner mappings; extend locally rather than regenerate components.
invariants.evidence: Composes owned components and maps existing resolved settings; rejects reinitialization/regeneration/style swaps and requires a scoped upstream diff for missing primitives.

invariants.text: Treat RTL/portals as a compatibility check, preserve fonts/tokens and avoid claiming an unperformed browser check.
invariants.evidence: Separately traces document/provider direction, portal CSS/fonts and nested overlays; preserves approved fonts/tokens and explicitly labels compatibility, browser and font checks as unperformed.

invariants.text: Prefer existing CSS for the small disclosure/feedback change; do not add Motion or redesign by default.
invariants.evidence: Retains the working CSS disclosure, local shadcn components and approved foundations; explicitly says Motion/Animate UI/dependencies are unjustified for this small change.

invariants.text: Reduced/off behavior cannot control authoritative save state; preserve truthful unknown outcomes and independent completion/focus handling.
invariants.evidence: Uses immediate reduced/off disclosure and static saving feedback; close/focus and authoritative outcomes are independent of animation callbacks. Unknown commit stays unknown and retry requires reconciliation/idempotency; later edits remain dirty.

invariants.text: Justify optional Motion by task tracking/layout change rather than blanket decoration; keep dependency choice conditional.
invariants.evidence: Justifies conditional Motion for tracking layout/insertion/reordering, reuses any existing engine first and makes adoption contingent on stack/API/license/payload review.

invariants.text: Provide non-drag actions, reduced/off alternatives, remote-update stability and relevant mobile checks.
invariants.evidence: Provides visible Move controls/keyboard alternatives, static reduced/off feedback, stable IDs and remote-conflict handling without focus theft; lists real-device/performance/interruption checks as planned.

invariants.text: Adopt only needed Animate UI controls after checking existing Motion and primitive APIs; preserve customized source and semantic owner icons.
invariants.evidence: Adopts only compatible selected sheet/icons, reuses existing Motion and primitive contracts, preserves customized shadcn source and routes icon animation through semantic owner mappings.

invariants.text: Preserve Persian RTL/font/spacing, inspect portals and keyboard/focus, and honor reduced/off without claiming execution.
invariants.evidence: Retains Persian RTL, Vazirmatn and spacing; checks actual portals, keyboard/focus and interruption, and distinguishes reduced from fully off. All runtime/API/render checks are explicitly pending.

invariants.text: Owner off and user off remain off; OS reduction limits owner standard and changes are handled live.
invariants.evidence: Uses the most restrictive owner/user/OS policy: owner off and user off cannot be raised; live OS reduction limits standard and unknown startup is static.

invariants.text: Apply resolved behavior to CSS loaders, icons and portals; interrupted closing preserves focus and logical state.
invariants.evidence: Applies policy to CSS/loaders, icons and portaled/independent overlays; interrupted close uses idempotent finalization and guarded callbacks to preserve focus, locks, current state and drafts.

invariants.text: MotionConfig reduction alone is not full off; suppress decorative fades/shimmer and non-Motion animation consumers too.
invariants.evidence: Identifies reduced MotionConfig as insufficient for off; requires immediate semantic states and suppression of CSS/opacity/shimmer/icons/portals without removing static loading feedback.

invariants.text: Decouple focus, cleanup and save outcomes from animation-end callbacks; prevent duplicate operations and reconcile unknown commits.
invariants.evidence: Separates semantic focus/cleanup/save state from completion callbacks, uses a synchronous submission guard and operation generations, and retains unknown outcomes until authoritative reconciliation or a safe retry contract.

invariants.text: Reject executable custom animation input and unbounded durations; use validated bounded declarative controls.
invariants.evidence: Rejects custom JavaScript, raw CSS/keyframes and unrestricted duration inputs at the trusted boundary; uses prepared Off/Subtle/Standard enums and protected design-system timing sources.

invariants.text: Keep drafts private until authorized atomic publication and preserve old preferences, failed-load fallback, conflict handling and rollback history.
invariants.evidence: Preserves private scoped drafts, atomic revision-checked publication, two-admin conflicts, explicit legacy preference migration, safe config-load fallback and new-version rollback with retained history.

invariants.text: Keep Vue, English-only scope and existing transitions; assess the bottleneck instead of assuming React-specific libraries help.
invariants.evidence: Retains Vue, English LTR and existing transitions, separates duration/rendering/network bottlenecks, and rejects React-only Animate UI or an unverified Motion adoption as a demonstrated speed fix.

invariants.text: Report only; do not modify the app, add a backend or create an appearance panel.
invariants.evidence: Explicit report-only proposal: no app edits, installs, admin backend/settings panel, library migration or invented browser/performance findings.

invariants.text: Use a safe consistent SSR/first-paint baseline before OS preference/config is known; avoid hydration mismatch and a standard-motion flash.
invariants.evidence: Requires visible static server/first-client content and matching markup/policy, with motion enabled only for future interactions after known valid preferences; no hidden entrance state or hydration flash.

invariants.text: Apply preference changes to CSS and copied controls; config failure and route cleanup preserve usable content, focus and truthful operation state.
invariants.evidence: Feeds CSS/copied/portaled controls, responds live to preferences, uses complete validated fallback without raising restrictions, and makes cleanup/focus/drafts/mutations independent of exit callbacks.
